title: Ordinary realization of cartesian open base change
statement: Let R_n be arbitrary commutative rings with transitions, n a natural number, and a:V→S, b:V→W, i:S→T, p:W→T a cartesian commutative square, with b and i open immersions. For the explicit ordinary realization and comparisons of [lem-sp-varying-ring-ordinary-evaluation-comparisons], realization carries the specified ordinary cartesian open comparison beta to the strict-tower derived beta: E_W(beta_N); j_b(a^*N); J_b(g_a,N) equals g_p,(i_!N); G_p(j_i,N); beta_(E_S N). No properness, clopen section factor, or pasting identity is assumed.

source.place: Construction 4.1 and Lemma 4.10; Stacks 03DI and 09AE for open adjunctions, 0F7B for the intrinsic clopen construction. This normalization is an agent-formulated consequence.

proof.text: Prove the square calculation for pullback comparison families satisfying the existing OrdinaryPullComposition predicate, then instantiate it with ordinaryComparisonNormalization. Combine those component morphism equations with equality elimination along a composite-map equality and the explicit moduleSquareG and StrictTower.squareG hom formulas. A generic morphism compositor-cube calculation, followed by inverse-isomorphism cancellation, yields ordinaryPull_square_inv. Keep the comparison families abstract and every compositor formula argument explicit to avoid large kernel reductions.

Both inverse cartesian beta transformations are inverse mates of their squareG inverse by their defining Hom transposes. Apply mateEquiv_vcomp and naturality under the outside pullback comparisons. The one-open normalization ordinaryOpen_mate identifies the other two mates; the preceding square equation identifies the pasted right-adjoint squares. Injectivity of mateEquiv gives ordinaryBeta_inv. Cancel the invertible beta and realization comparisons to obtain precisely the original forward OrdinarySquareComparison equation.

theorem ordinaryCartesianEvaluation (n : ℕ) {V W S T : Scheme.{u}}
    (a : V ⟶ S) (b : V ⟶ W) (i : S ⟶ T) (p : W ⟶ T)
    [IsOpenImmersion b] [IsOpenImmersion i]
    (h : a ≫ i = b ≫ p) (hsq : IsPullback a b i p) :
    OrdinarySquareComparison
      (EA := ordinaryRealization R φ n V) (EB := ordinaryRealization R φ n W)
      (EC := ordinaryRealization R φ n S) (ED := ordinaryRealization R φ n T)
      (R₀ := pull R φ a) (P₀ := pull R φ p)
      (K := extension R φ b) (I := extension R φ i)
      (r := StrictTower.G (R n) a) (p := StrictTower.G (R n) p)
      (k := StrictTower.J (R n) b) (i := StrictTower.J (R n) i)
      (ordinaryPullComparison R φ n V S a) (ordinaryPullComparison R φ n W T p)
      (ordinaryOpenComparison R φ n V W b) (ordinaryOpenComparison R φ n S T i)
      (moduleBeta R φ a b i p h hsq).hom
      (StrictTower.beta (R n) a b i p h hsq).hom
